answer: An agent's activity thread counts only when three auditors each hang one lantern on it; each lights at most 20 threads per epoch. A walnut deposit of 5 credits per vouch is the floor: identity 1 costs 15. Auditor capacity is fixed, so bribes double every 40 fakes, ten cost ~179 and a hundred cost 8,484. A vouch binds to one thread, so one bribed auditor cannot cover two fakes.
